patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Mailjet and Omnisend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Mailjet and Omnisend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Omnisend's shape. Choose Omnisend only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric automation — a common” rather than Mailjet's shape. Workflow advantage: Mailjet leans shared coverage; Omnisend leans ecommerce-email. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Mailjet and Omnisend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch).; Omnisend is Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric automation — a common Klaviyo alternative..
- Company-size focus: Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Omnisend (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Mailjet-leaning — vs Omnisend-leaning ecommerce-email.
- Researched limits: Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Omnisend — Standard email send caps scale with contacts — heavy senders may need Pro.

Limitations — Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+; Omnisend: Standard email send caps scale with contacts — heavy senders may need Pro; Live intro discounts complicate quoting non-promo monthly floors.

Poor-fit cases: Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Omnisend is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Standard email send caps scale with contacts — heavy senders may need Pro · Avoid Mailjet if you actually need Omnisend's motion (Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric automation )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
